content.title: Get hired to show people what a city
content.lead: Mingla Creators make the videos and photos that help people choose. Become a Creator and complete paid gigs for places and events on Mingla.

items.title: Set up your profile
items.body: Build your profile in Mingla. Creator mode stays private until every readiness check is complete.

items.title: Get hired
items.body: See the city, format, dates and budget before you raise your hand. Host names stay private until a hire is agreed.

items.title: Get paid
items.body: Your contract, delivery and payout status stay together. Mingla does not turn your earnings into a wallet balance.

content.after: inside Mingla before your first gig.

content.title: One honest review,
content.lead: Mingla chooses up to three Locals in each open city. Complete one useful, independent place review each month and earn $150 after approval.

items.title: Choose one eligible place
items.body: Pick somewhere in your city that no Mingla Local has covered recently and where you have no personal or paid connection.

items.title: Visit on your own terms
items.body: Go during the month and pay for your own visit. The $150 monthly payment is designed to cover the outing and your work.

items.title: Publish a useful first-hand review
items.body: Share a specific written review, strong photos or a short video, and your disclosed social post. Mingla reviews the work, not the place.

items.title: $150 after approval
items.body: Your payout is converted into your payout currency when it is queued, shown to you, and sent through your connected payout provider. It never comes from the place you reviewed.

items.title: Trust comes first
items.body: You must disclose the Mingla Local relationship. Personal ties and recent paid work with a place make it ineligible. A place may reply publicly, but it cannot choose, pay or silence you.

content.heading: Your city, *in your words.*
content.body: Applications appear in Mingla only when a city is open. With three seats per city, a thoughtful sample matters more than a giant following.

content.title: Making real life *easier to find.*
content.lead: Mingla is the app for what to do, and the operating system for the places that make a city worth going out in.

content.question: What is Mingla?
content.answer: Mingla is one platform with an Explorer experience for people choosing what to do and a Host experience for businesses and organisers creating, promoting and running the places, events and experiences they can choose.

content.heading: Good plans shouldn’t be *hard to find.*
paragraphs: The best places in a city are often the hardest to find: the class with ten spots, the gallery late night, the café everyone’s friend knows about. Mingla puts them where people plan.
We don’t match strangers. Mingla is for couples, friends, groups and solo plans: the people you already have, and the plans you haven’t made yet.
And for hosts, Mingla is the growth and operating system that helps places with soul get found and booked.

content.sub: Tickets, guest lists, door scanning and an AI demand forecast, in one place built for the people who throw the night, from the first post to a packed room.

content.intro: You bring the night. Mingla puts it where people are already deciding what to do this weekend, then gives you the tools to sell it, run the door and bring the same crowd back.
content.big: People don’t search for a category. They search for a plan. Put the *date, the place and the price* together, say what’s included in plain words, and give them *one link to book.*

content.heading: Everything between *the flyer and the door.*
content.lead: Built around how events actually run: the build, the sale, the night and the follow-up.

items.title: Sell it your way
items.body: One night, a whole weekend or every Friday. Online, in person or both. Free RSVPs or paid tickets, priced in your currency.

items.title: Know who’s coming
items.body: Guest lists and groups, ticket scanning at the door, and an AI demand forecast so you can plan the room before you book it.

items.title: Bring them back
items.body: Send the next date to the people who came last time, before the flyer. Email campaigns to a group, discount codes and referrals.

content.body: How many people will actually show up? Get a turnout forecast, and see what your promo budget can buy. Free, in under a minute.

items.question: Can I publish a free event without connecting a bank?
items.answer: Yes. Free events publish without one. You only connect a bank when you sell paid tickets.

items.question: Can I sell in naira?
items.answer: Yes. Nigerian brands price in naira, and your address chooses the payment network that pays you out.

items.question: Does Mingla see my bank details?
items.answer: No. Your bank details are handled by the payment provider and never touch Mingla.

items.question: What about weekly or multi-day events?
items.answer: Both are built in: set it once as a recurring or multi-day event and sell each date.

content.line2: let the group pay in parts.
content.sub: Itineraries, payment plans and a group chat that keeps everyone on the same page, from the first deposit to the last day of the trip you planned together.

content.intro: Group trips fall apart in the chat. Mingla gives the plan a home: one page with the itinerary, the price and the way to pay, and one place to talk.
content.big: Price it *per person,* show the *whole day by day,* and let people pay *in parts.* The trip stops being a maybe in a group chat and becomes a plan with a date.

content.heading: From idea to *wheels up.*
content.lead: Everything a trip host juggles, in the order it actually happens.

items.title: Itineraries people trust
items.body: Lay out every day with times, places and what’s included, so people can see the trip before they commit to it.

items.title: Pay in instalments
items.body: Take a deposit, then the rest in parts. Fewer drop-outs, and no chasing people for money in DMs.

items.title: One group chat
items.body: Updates, reminders and questions live with the trip, not scattered across five apps.

content.body: Price a group trip in a minute: real hotels and activities, a full cost sheet, and exactly what to charge per person. Free.

items.question: Can people pay in instalments?
items.answer: Yes. Instalments are built into trips, so people can pay a deposit and then the rest in parts.

items.question: Where does the group talk?
items.answer: Each trip has its own group chat, so updates and questions stay with the plan.

items.question: Can I share the itinerary before people book?
items.answer: Yes. The trip page shows the day by day, so people can see the plan before they pay.

content.sub: Workshops, classes, tastings and tours: list the sessions, take bookings, sell the spots and fill the next one with the people who loved the last one.

content.intro: Experiences sell when people can picture themselves there. Mingla shows the moment, the time and the price in one place, and makes the next step one tap.
content.big: Give people three things: *context,* what it is and why it matters; *vibe,* real moments and what to expect; and *a next step,* the date, place, price and one link to book.

content.heading: Run sessions, *not spreadsheets.*
content.lead: For the hosts whose product is an afternoon people remember.

items.title: Sessions on repeat
items.body: Set up a weekly class or a one-off workshop, with spots, prices and what’s included on every date.

items.title: Price it properly
items.body: Sale prices, automatic discounts and codes for regulars, so a full class doesn’t mean an underpriced one.

items.title: Fill the next one
items.body: Send the next date to everyone who came before, and let referrals do the rest.

content.body: Priced by guilt? See your true cost per head, including your own time, and the price you should actually charge. Free.

items.question: Can I run the same class every week?
items.answer: Yes. Set it up as a recurring event and each date sells on its own.

items.question: Can I offer a discount to regulars?
items.answer: Yes: discount codes, sale prices and automatic discounts are built in.

items.question: Can I take free RSVPs for a taster session?
items.answer: Yes. Free RSVP events publish without a bank account.

content.sub: A venue listing that sells the room, with reservations, table ordering, menu intelligence and a demand forecast for the nights ahead, all in one place.

content.intro: People don’t pick a restaurant from a map pin. They pick a feeling. Mingla matches your place to the people already looking for it, then helps you run the service.
content.big: Fill in the checklist once: a *hero cover,* at least *five photos,* your website, *typical spend,* the *“best for”* tags that match how people use your place, and a few quick yes-or-no answers. Then Mingla can *match you to the right people.*

content.heading: From first look to *last table.*
content.lead: The listing that gets you chosen, and the tools that run the room once they arrive.

items.title: A listing that sells the room
items.body: A video cover, up to twenty photos, typical spend and “best for” tags, so people see the experience, not just the address.

items.title: Reservations & table ordering
items.body: Take bookings and orders in one place, and build your menu once for every surface.

items.title: Know the nights ahead
items.body: Menu intelligence and a demand forecast show what’s selling and which nights need a push.

content.body: Find out what your website says to a first-timer, and exactly what it’s costing you. Free report in 60 seconds.

items.question: What does Mingla need to recommend my venue?
items.answer: A hero cover (a short video stands out most), at least five photos, your website, typical spend, “best for” tags and a few quick yes-or-no questions.

items.question: How many photos can I add?
items.answer: At least five and up to twenty.

items.question: Can I build my menu in Mingla?
items.answer: Yes. The menu builder sets it up once for your listing and table ordering.

content.sub: List the stay, the day passes and the events on your grounds, and market them to the people planning their next getaway or a day by the pool.

content.intro: A getaway starts as a plan someone makes with friends. Mingla puts your property, your beach days and your events in front of them while they’re still deciding.
content.big: Sell more than the room. *Beach days, pool parties, brunches* and *weekend packages* are plans people share, and every one of them is a way *back to your property.*

content.heading: The stay is the start, *not the whole story.*
content.lead: Turn your grounds into a calendar people want to be part of.

items.title: Days and events on your grounds
items.body: Sell day passes, beach days and parties as events, with tickets, guest lists and scanning at the gate.

items.title: A listing that feels like a getaway
items.body: Video cover, galleries and “best for” tags show the experience, not just the room types.

items.title: Email and SMS that bring them back
items.body: Nurture past guests with campaigns for the next season, the next long weekend and the next event.

content.body: Find out what your website says to a first-timer, and exactly what it’s costing you. Free report in 60 seconds.

items.question: Can I sell day passes and events, not just stays?
items.answer: Yes. Anything on your grounds can be listed and sold as an event with tickets.

items.question: Can I market to past guests?
items.answer: Yes. Email and SMS campaigns go to the groups you build from your guest lists.

items.question: Can I price in my own currency?
items.answer: Yes. Prices follow your brand’s country, including naira for Nigeria.

content.sub: Openings, exhibitions, talks and late nights, listed where people plan their weekend, with tickets or free RSVPs and a guest list that comes back.

content.intro: People want more from a weekend than another dinner. Mingla puts your exhibitions and events in the plan, with the context that makes them easy to say yes to.
content.big: Local discovery is *bigger than restaurants.* Culture competes for the same weekend, and people are really asking: *is it worth leaving the house,* who is it for, and *how do I book?* Answer those and you’re in the plan.

content.heading: From the opening *to the next visit.*
content.lead: For spaces whose calendar is the reason to come back.

items.title: Every opening, listed
items.body: Exhibitions, openings, talks and late nights, each with its own page, date and way in.

items.title: Tickets or free RSVPs
items.body: Charge for entry or take free RSVPs so you know who’s coming, and scan them in at the door.

items.title: A list that comes back
items.body: Every visitor joins your list, so the next exhibition starts with an audience.

content.heading: Built for *art & culture* of every size.

content.body: Priced by guilt? See your true cost per head, including your own time, and the price you should actually charge. Free.

items.question: Can we take free RSVPs?
items.answer: Yes. Free events publish without a bank account, and you still get a guest list.

items.question: Can we list a long-running exhibition?
items.answer: Yes. Multi-day and recurring events cover exhibitions and regular late nights.

items.question: Can visitors find us without an event on?
items.answer: Yes. Your venue listing stays on Mingla between events.

content.sub: Bowling, arcades, karaoke, escape rooms and game nights: take bookings for lanes, rooms and parties, and be the answer when a group asks what to do tonight.

content.intro: Groups are the hardest plans to make and the best customers to win. Mingla puts your place in front of them with the details that get the whole chat to say yes.
content.big: Show the *fun,* not the floor plan. A *short video,* the *typical spend,* who it’s *best for* and one way to *book the group,* and you stop being a maybe.

content.heading: Nights that sell *themselves.*
content.lead: From walk-ins to tournament nights, run the busy side of fun.

items.title: A listing that shows the fun
items.body: Video cover, galleries and “best for” tags like groups, birthdays and date night.

items.title: Theme nights & tournaments
items.body: Sell league nights, tournaments and parties as events with tickets, guest lists and scanning.

items.title: Reservations for groups
items.body: Take bookings for lanes, rooms and tables, and see the busy nights coming with a demand forecast.

content.body: Find out what your website says to a first-timer, and exactly what it’s costing you. Free report in 60 seconds.

items.question: Can I sell tournament nights?
items.answer: Yes. List them as events with tickets, a guest list and scanning at the door.

items.question: Can groups book ahead?
items.answer: Yes. Reservations let groups book lanes, rooms or tables.

items.question: What should my listing show?
items.answer: A hero cover (a short video stands out most), at least five photos, typical spend and “best for” tags.
